name: SNS Network Technology Berhad
summary: SNS Network Technology Berhad, established in 1998 and based in Ipoh, Malaysia, is a leading provider of integrated technology and information systems. The company caters to a diverse clientele, including individual consumers, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), large corporations, educational institutions, and government agencies. Their extensive product portfolio features a wide array of ITC hardware such as laptops, tablets, smartphones, monitors, projectors, and digital signages, alongside networking equipment, cameras, security and CCTV systems, and various software solutions. Beyond physical products, SNS Network delivers comprehensive Information and Communication Technology (ICT) services. These advanced solutions encompass cloud computing, digital transformation initiatives, network infrastructure development, robust security management software, surveillance, and web services. They also offer specialized services for enterprise environments, educational sectors, IT asset and resource management, application deployment, and sustainable technology practices. The company further supports clients with critical IT infrastructure services, including disaster recovery, data backup, and "as-a-service" offerings (Infrastructure, Platform, and Software). Their managed services include helpdesk support, server management, Wi-Fi networks, router and switch administration, and managed load balancing. For cybersecurity, they provide anti-DDoS measures, managed firewalls, and endpoint protection. Additionally, SNS Network offers broadband connectivity, repair services, and system upgrades. SNS Network markets its own ICT brands, namely iTworld, GLOO, and JOI, in addition to distributing a broad selection of third-party branded ICT products. The company maintains an international presence, operating across Malaysia, Hong Kong, Singapore, Australia, Brunei, Indonesia, Maldives, and Vietnam.
